title: Argentinian Empanadas with Airy Filling
description: A classic South American dish, these empanadas are filled with a light and airy mixture of cheese, meat, and spices.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt. Gradually add lard or shortening, and mix until dough is formed.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix shredded beef, chopped onion, salt, and black pepper.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of beef mixture onto one half of each circle. Top with grated cheese.
Fold dough in half and press edges together to seal. Use a fork to crimp edges.
Place empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
